name: lumora-design-system
description: Tokens e componentes SCSS do Lumora, independentes de framework.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && node scripts/build-assets.mjs && npm run build:pages
scripts.build:css: sass --no-source-map styles/lumora.scss dist/lumora.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed styles/lumora.scss dist/lumora.min.css && sass --no-source-map examples/design-system.scss dist/design-system.css && sass --no-source-map styles/pages/auth.scss dist/auth.css
